name: baiyuxi-agent-studio-build-week

scripts.check: pnpm --filter @agent-studio/shared lint && pnpm --filter @agent-studio/finance lint && pnpm --filter @agent-studio/mcp-server lint && pnpm --filter @agent-studio/api lint && pnpm --filter @agent-studio/web exec tsc --noEmit
